ck: praticnatyaharaprasankatityatra praticnapataprayokanarnaprakasanapurvakan na tatyuktan srutiyuktivirotati tyatra tikaya akalankitvapratarsanan astu va katancit yuktisaptasrutiyuktyupayapara iti tatapi tata kinityanuyoke nopateyaniti paranasatyanatyaharyaneva tatitan tusananutacikataneva tikakrtyata "praticnatyaharaprasankace "ti yatatroktan kenacit "praticnEkatese satye praticnasaptaprayoktaran sricayatirtanuninevaskantate svayate saptaprayoke iti tosa" iti tana pavanavapotat tatahyatravahitananopiritan tyayeta na tat yuktan srutiyuktivirotat iti nulavakyanasti atrEvan yocana karya tE yato na tatyuktanato na tat vityata …. srutirapi krhyate cetapyevan satitan pavati prahnanokunatvan akunatve srutyantarasya tatparyanirnayakopakranatirupasrutyupetan saksatsvasatakayuktyupetan ca na pavati, srutiyuktivirotatiti tata ca saksatakunatvapratipatakanan upakranatilinkarupatvena kevalan tatparyanirnayakananakananan nisetepi saksatakunatvapratipatakanan niskalan niskriyan kevalo nirkunascetyatinanakananananisetaprasankat tata ca sarvataprananikatvasyapyapraticnatatvaprasanka tata casatitenaprananikatvena katananupateyatvasatanan sanpavatityalocyan caturanatipiriti 1 tena svayate saptaprayoke iti tosopi nasnan sprsati api tu praticnEkatese satye praticnasaptaprayoktaran sricayatirtanuninevaskantateyan tosa svan. can.pa. vake- 231 … iti, atavasanancasaniti, atavanupateyaniti atra yatyapi tatiti tarnivacakan patan cakarti ato na vityata ityatisatyapatanevatyahriyeta tatapyatyahrta-satyapatartenanvayartan tatityasyavrti karya tata ca na kevalan satyapatatyaharo vitiyeta kintu tatityavartyetapiti sucayitukanasrinacayatirtakurusarvapOna prayuncata sartakan laksanikan praticnapataniti na praticnapatan tatpratapreksa pracna pracanati, “yati kevalan satyapatatyaharovivaksisyata tarhi tatEva prayoksyata na prayoci tata prayucyata ca praticnapatan tenetan sityati, yatkrtepi satyapatatyahare yata praticnarupata syat tata
